prompts.background: Use case: illustration-story, production BACKGROUND plate for a polished children's 2D interactive science and art workshop. Match the attached Bluey-style family home: yellow timber walls, white window frames, leafy sunny garden. Camera close to a real child-height workbench, slightly looking down at its broad honey-wood tabletop. Landscape 16:9, richly illustrated hand-painted cartoon, crisp warm dark outlines, tactile wood grain, gentle dimensional highlights and soft contact shadows, joyful saturated teal and coral accents. TOP 35 percent: cozy wall, sunny window mostly upper left, small wall shelf upper right with a few closed books and a little potted plant; small wordless rainbow poster. LOWER 65 percent: one large CONTINUOUS completely EMPTY warm wooden worktop filling screen edge-to-edge, shallow perspective, front rounded edge visible at bottom, teal table apron. The tabletop center and sides must be entirely clear for separately layered interactive bowls, toy boats, magnets and coloring sheets. No equipment, bowls, boats, pencils, beakers, mats or paper painted on the table. NO characters, NO text, NO UI, NO buttons. Thoughtfully composed beautiful toy-room illustration, not a flat solid fill or web-page mockup. This is only the empty architectural/workbench layer.
prompts.props: Use case: illustration-story. A production TRANSPARENT sprite atlas for a polished illustrated toddler science workshop. Style matches Bluey-like warm painted toy props, rich joyful colors, crisp dark brown-blue outlines, gently dimensional highlights and natural soft shading, not flat icons. Exactly FOUR columns and THREE rows, equal cells, each item isolated inside its own cell with generous transparent margins. Nothing overlaps or extends outside its cell. Slight front three-quarter view consistent across every toy. Row 1: a small narrow YELLOW open toy cargo boat with an empty deck and no sail; a much wider TURQUOISE open toy cargo boat with an empty deck and no sail; a large RED horseshoe magnet with pale metal pole ends; a thick gray STEEL WASHER. Row 2: a chunky WOODEN CUBE; a glossy RED PLASTIC BUTTON with four holes; a crumpled SILVER ALUMINUM FOIL BALL; a small ORANGE TOY CRATE for boat cargo. Row 3: a small RED toy adjustable spotlight pointing upward and inward; the exact same GREEN spotlight; the exact same BLUE spotlight; a chunky WHITE CRAYON with simple pale paper wrapper, dark outline and white tip, upright tilted very slightly right. No light beams painted in, no water painted in, no characters, no text, no logos, no borders. Every item completely visible, separated, uncropped. True alpha transparency.
prompts.bowl: Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent sprite sheet with TWO horizontal equal panels side by side, each a matching 600x450 coordinate registration layer for the SAME clear round glass science mixing bowl. Charming polished Bluey-like 2D hand-painted toy workshop illustration, warm dark teal outlines, dimensional glass, delightful professional game art. Bowl occupies x=95..505 and y=150..375 within each 600x450 panel (y increases downward). LEFT panel: REAR layer of EMPTY clear bowl: back half of oval thick rolled rim, pale blue translucent back glass and elliptical base, no front rim. RIGHT panel: FRONT overlay layer: ONLY the front half arc of the exact matching bowl rim and thin front curved outline, two bright glass highlight streaks on each side, faint translucent blue tint at extreme edges. Center of right panel MUST BE TRANSPARENT so live colored liquid behind remains entirely visible. Both panels are same size and align exactly when stacked. No background, no table, no mat, no shadow outside bowl, no labels, no text, no ingredients, no liquid. Generous empty transparent margins. Clear separate back and front layers, not two ordinary complete bowls.
